command.name: Command Tree
command.why: Steady power floor. Respec is free here.

upgrades.name: Logistics
upgrades.text: +1 army cap per rank.

upgrades.name: Toughness
upgrades.text: +5% squad HP per rank.

upgrades.name: Marksmanship
upgrades.text: +5% damage per rank.

upgrades.name: Ready Reserves
upgrades.text: +1 starting AP per rank.

upgrades.name: Extra Orders
upgrades.text: +1 draft reroll per chapter per rank.

upgrades.name: Field Promotion
upgrades.text: Start each chapter by drafting 1 Common boon.

upgrades.name: Sapper Doctrine
upgrades.text: Sapper boons appear in drafts: Break, explosives, anti-armor.

upgrades.name: Duo Cards
upgrades.text: Duo boons appear when you hold boons from two matching doctrines.

upgrades.name: Captured Relics
upgrades.text: Relic boons appear in drafts and caches. Strong, with a price.

upgrades.name: Cursed Contracts
upgrades.text: Curse boons can appear: a strong effect tied to a drawback.

upgrades.name: Sniper Teams
upgrades.text: Recruit Sniper Teams: back-row precision that beats Support.

upgrades.name: Hero: Doc Halloran
upgrades.text: The best medic in the division. Heals everyone and pulls squads back from the brink.

upgrades.name: Hero: Lt. Vasquez "Ghost"
upgrades.text: A legendary sniper. Deletes key targets and breaks bosses.

upgrades.name: Veteran Recruits
upgrades.text: Squads start each chapter at Veteran rank.

upgrades.name: Scoped Optics
upgrades.text: +6% crit chance for the whole army.

upgrades.name: Grenade Crates
upgrades.text: Start each chapter with 2 Grenade Crates.

upgrades.name: Medical Locker
upgrades.text: Start each chapter with a Med Kit and Stimulants.

upgrades.name: Lantern Shard
upgrades.text: Captured relic. Battles open with 2 Burn on every enemy.

upgrades.name: Better Supply Drops
upgrades.text: Supply drops stock one more boon and cost 15% less.

upgrades.name: Field Hospital Tents
upgrades.text: Field camps heal 50% instead of 35%.

upgrades.name: Pay Chest
upgrades.text: Start each chapter with 40 more gold.
